test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (Quant) (Held On: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: maths
question: ABCD is a quadrilateral. The length of the diagonal AC is 24 cm. The sum of the perpendicular drawn from vertex B and D on the diagonal AC is 10 cm. What is the area of the quadrilateral?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of a quadrilateral given one diagonal and perpendiculars from opposite vertices is calculated as:

Area = 1/2 × Diagonal × (Sum of perpendiculars)

Area = 1/2 × 24 × 10

Area = 12 × 10 = 120 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 120 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of diagonal (AC) = 24 cm

Sum of perpendiculars (h₁ + h₂) = 10 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of Quadrilateral = Area of ΔABC + Area of ΔADC

Area = (1/2 × AC × h₁) + (1/2 × AC × h₂) = 1/2 × AC × (h₁ + h₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d9991d63a2f228570eccd9708bfffaa7f027d599bca9b705132afebfc7a7bfe.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = 1/2 × AC × (h₁ + h₂)

⇒ Area = 1/2 × 24 × 10

⇒ Area = 12 × 10

⇒ Area = 120 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 120 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Rhombus

If d₁ and d₂ are the lengths of the two diagonals of a rhombus, then Area = 1/2 × d₁ × d₂.

Area of Trapezium

Area = 1/2 × (Sum of parallel sides) × Height = 1/2 × (a + b) × h.

Area of Parallelogram

Area = Base × Corresponding Height = b × h.</p
